Site.description: An independent firm specialized in corporate & government affairs in Colombia. We support regulated companies, in-house legal and compliance teams in scenarios where the decision must hold up before a regulator, a judge, or public opinion.

Footer.coverage: National coverage and the Andean region.

Hero.headline: Defensible decisions, ahead of the noise
Hero.lede: The first firm in Colombia specialized in {discipline}. We support regulated companies, in-house legal and compliance teams in scenarios where the decision must hold up before a regulator, a judge, or public opinion.
Hero.photoCaption: Working session with partners · Workshops and consulting
Hero.photoAlt: Working session with clients and partners

card.headline: Organizations that defend complex decisions.
card.sectorsValue: Energy, infrastructure, financial services, healthcare, and regulated technology.
card.footnote: Every engagement is led by a responsible partner and staffed by teams of three to five people, with documented, traceable deliverables.

publicAnalysis.label: Public analysis
publicAnalysis.value: Economic and political outlook, legislative monitoring.

Methodology.headline: Four steps, one methodology
Methodology.intro: Every engagement follows the same sequence. What changes is the scope and the team — never the rigor of the process.

diagnosis.title: Diagnosis
diagnosis.body: We map the regulatory, political, and reputational context. We identify the stakeholders, the risks, and the decisions at stake.

plan.title: Work plan
plan.body: We design a plan with scope, deliverables, timelines, and a single responsible partner. We validate it with you before execution.

execution.title: Execution with dialogue
execution.body: Teams of three to five people, with regular progress and adjustment meetings. You always speak with the same point of contact.

delivery.title: Delivery and follow-up
delivery.body: Documented deliverables, with traceable methodology and sources. A closing session with follow-up recommendations.

Services.headline: Four lines of work, one methodology
Services.intro: We help our clients build robust institutional positions, grounded in technical analysis and a deep understanding of Colombia's regulatory and political environment.

institutionalRelations.title: Institutional Relations
institutionalRelations.summary: Building and managing strategic relationships with key public and private stakeholders.

riskAndCrisis.title: Risk and Crisis Management
riskAndCrisis.summary: Early identification, mitigation, and management of high-impact reputational or operational scenarios.

regulatory.title: Regulatory and Legislative Affairs
regulatory.summary: Monitoring, analysis, and technical engagement in regulatory and legislative processes.

esg.title: ESG Communications and Sustainability
esg.summary: Communication strategies aligned with environmental, social, and governance standards.

Manifesto.quote: We don't make the decision for you: we make it defensible.
Manifesto.lead: Influence, technical rigor, and risk mitigation.
Manifesto.body1: We work under strict standards of confidentiality, independence, and compliance. Every engagement is led by a responsible partner and staffed by teams of three to five people.
Manifesto.body2: We apply risk analysis, regulatory monitoring, and stakeholder mapping methodologies to translate complex contexts into defensible decisions.

Equipo.headline: A founding partner, with a public-sector track record
Equipo.intro: Temptum is led by professionals with experience in journalism, corporate communications, and public affairs. Every engagement is led from start to finish.
Equipo.quote: Closeness with the client and technical depth are the two things you cannot compromise on.
Equipo.quoteFooter: Silvia Juliana Parra Cañas · CEO and Founding Partner
Equipo.body: More than a decade building communication strategies, managing high-profile crises, and strengthening the positioning of national and international brands in Colombia and the Andean region.
Equipo.formationValue: Master's in Journalism, Universidad del Rosario. BA in Social Communication and Journalism, Universidad Jorge Tadeo Lozano.
Equipo.trajectoryValue: Edelman, Millenium Group, SPR Group & Marco de Comunicaciones. Previously, investigative reporter at Publicaciones Semana and Dinero magazine.
Equipo.teachingValue: Lecturer in Public Relations, Communication Strategy, and Marketing and Political Communication at Universidad del Rosario and Universidad Jorge Tadeo Lozano.

IntelligenceCenter.headline: Strategic information, before you need it.
IntelligenceCenter.intro: Outlook and legislative monitoring produced by our team. Distributed under institutional subscription — let's talk to assess whether the scope applies to your organization.

outlook.title: Economic and Political Outlook 2025
outlook.summary: Macroeconomic panorama, Congress's legislative agenda, and sectoral regulatory priorities, with impact scenarios for corporate decision-making in Colombia.

monitoring.title: Sectoral Legislative Monitoring
monitoring.summary: Quarterly tracking of bills, decrees, and committee agendas, with a prioritization matrix and executive summaries by initiative.

beso-muerte-rubiales.title: The Kiss of Death: The Reputational Fall of Rubiales
beso-muerte-rubiales.resumen: A reputational autopsy of the Spanish federation president's gesture. Five factors explain why some scandals turn into a death spiral and others don't, and what crisis-management teams can learn from this case.

compliance-comunicaciones.title: Compliance and Communications: The Convergence Latin American Boards Can't Ignore
compliance-comunicaciones.resumen: How the separation between legal compliance and corporate communications is becoming operationally untenable — and why the boards of regulated companies need to rebuild the bridge between the two functions.

good-will.title: Goodwill Is Built in the Years You Don't Need It
good-will.resumen: Most institutions only remember institutional relations when they need a favor. The ones that build durable relationships in the years when no one is asking are the ones that, in a crisis, find a phone that gets answered.

ia-socio-silencioso.title: AI, the Silent Partner in Strategic Communications
ia-socio-silencioso.resumen: Generative AI is already embedded in the workflow of any communications team that processes information at scale. The question isn't whether to use it, but how to govern its use without losing the editorial judgment that's the actual differentiator.
